name: uhta-crew
description: **uhta** (*ūhta*, m., "the last part of the night, before dawn") is a browser god-game about emotional contagion. You play a kaiju-scale being born as a counterpoint to Uhtcearu, the world's grieving god, and the game asks one question: *what will you make people feel, and what will that do to the world?* NPCs sit on a −12..+12 emotion scale; every Sleep runs a generation of contagion you cannot micromanage. The playable slice is `build/uhta-slice.html` in the game repo. This repo is not the game — it is the five-agent crew that produces the **data file the game boots from**.
